description: One canonical entity-id namespace shared across the project's runtime data files. Each file lists the ids it DEFINES (its own top-level entities) and, per sibling file, the ids it REFERENCES there. Every referenced id MUST appear in the target file's `defines`, so cross-file references resolve at runtime.

file.description: Data file path exactly as it appears in the blueprint (e.g. rooms.yaml).

defines.description: Canonical ids this file defines as its top-level entities.

references.description: sibling file path -> the ids this file references there. Each id MUST be in that sibling's `defines`.
